description: This file defines a PHP class for compiling the {rdelim} tag within the Smarty templating engine. The class extends a base compiler class for delimiters and provides functionality to output the right delimiter in templates during compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Rdelim
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {rdelim} tag in Smarty templates, extending the Ldelim compiler class and returning the right delimiter.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {rdelim} tag, returning the right delimiter for Smarty templates.
